name: Surplus Muscle
text: Whenever you win a trick with an ace, your highest card of that suit gains +3 rank.

signature.trigger: you win a trick with an ace
signature.target: your highest card of that suit

archetypes: High Card; splash Kingmaker, Spade Master
role: Enabler (feeds win triggers and Unclouded Sun)
decision: Which ace to cash first: the one whose suit holds a king or queen that becomes the next ace, and whether to keep leading the suit while opponents still follow.
opponent: Each raise is shown. Opponents can trump the suit once they are void to stop the chain.
aiNote: Cash aces in suits where you hold a jack or better first, then lead the raised card next.
rationale: Each ace win promotes the next card of its suit: a jack, queen, or king becomes an ace, and a ten becomes a king, so a suit headed by an ace often runs two or three deep, about half a trick a round. With Unclouded Sun (DU-S01) the new aces can't be trumped either, the intended High Card payoff. Raised cards that become aces chain onward, which opponents stop by trumping once void.
deviation: Redesigned from an ace-affinity sigil whose rank beyond ace spilled to another card, which was hard to read.
